map.调用浏览器麦克风实时采集声音并用Web Audio分析音高，显示当前音名与偏差，: Uses the browser mic to capture sound in real time and analyzes pitch via Web Audio, showing the note name and deviation—helping tune guitar, bass, ukulele, etc.; pure client-side, no network.
map.吉他/尤克里里对着麦克风调音，看指针与音分偏差: Tune guitar/ukulele to the mic; watch the needle and cent deviation
map.乐器走音时测偏差方向（偏高/偏低）微调弦钮: When out of tune, find deviation direction (sharp/flat) and trim the tuner
map.教学里演示音分概念，±5 音分内即准: Teach the cent concept; within ±5 cents is in tune
map.：指针居中且 |音分|≤5 显示「准确」；+24.6 cents 提示「偏高」，: : Needle centered and |cents|≤5 shows 'Accurate'; +24.6 cents shows 'Sharp'—loosen the string to lower frequency toward 440 Hz.
map.麦克风取声→FFT/自相关得基频→按十二平均律算最近音名与音分偏差→指针指示偏高: Mic captures → FFT/autocorrelation yields fundamental → nearest note and cent deviation per 12-ET → needle shows sharp/flat; tune accordingly.
map.人耳对音高分辨约 5–6 音分，合奏要求更严（常<3），独奏/练习 ±5 内足够: Human pitch resolution is ~5–6 cents; ensembles demand tighter (<3); solo/practice within ±5 is enough.
